item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, math\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np = {'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncases = [\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2,'unit':'cm'},{'id':'b','amount':3}]}, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':0.02,'unit':'m'},{'id':'b','amount':3,'unit':'m'}],'errors':[]}),\\n ({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'b','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'c','amount':1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'d','amount':1},{'id':'d','amount':2}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'},{'row':3,'cause':'unit'},{'row':5,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\n]\\nfor request, expected in cases:\\n before = copy.deepcopy(request)\\n assert evaluate(request,p) == expected, (evaluate(request,p), expected)\\n assert request == before\\nassert evaluate({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':-1},{'id':'x','amount':1}]},p) == {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'duplicate'}]}\\nassert evaluate({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'x','amount':True}]},p) == {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'unit'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'}]}\\nprint('edge, priority, duplicate, and immutability checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: actual=json.load(f)\\nexpected=[evaluate(request,policy) for request in requests]\\nassert actual == expected, (actual, expected)\\nprint('report consistency passed')\"]}}]}"}
